title: ONOTE: Hypergraph-Grounded Omnimodal Reasoning for Computational Music Science
abstract: arXiv:2604.20719v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Omnimodal notation processing, centered on sheet music, is a controlled scientific setting in which auditory, visual, symbolic, and physical representations must encode the same musical events. Yet existing work remains fragmented across recognition and transcription, rarely testing structural consistency across notation systems. Western-staff bias and underspecified model judges further conceal errors in pitch, timing, ordering, and instrument-specific constraints. We introduce ONOTE, a unified framework that treats music as a scientifically structured domain of measurable cross-representation correspondences. Its test-only benchmark draws on a diverse collection of musical sources covering staff, Jianpu, and tablature across varied genres, instruments, and structural conditions, with aligned multimodal derivatives. translated_title: ONOTE：面向计算音乐科学的超图接地全模态推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.20719v2 公告类型：替换-交叉  摘要：以乐谱为核心的全模态记谱处理，是一个受控的科学环境，其中听觉、视觉、符号和物理表征必须编码相同的音乐事件。然而，现有工作仍分散在识别和转录领域，很少测试不同记谱系统之间的结构一致性。西方五线谱偏见和未充分定义的模型评判进一步掩盖了音高、时序、排序和乐器特定约束中的错误。我们引入了ONOTE，一个将音乐视为可测量跨表征对应关系的科学结构化领域的统一框架。其仅测试基准利用多样化的音乐来源集合，涵盖五线谱、简谱和指法谱，跨越多种流派、乐器和结构条件，并配以对齐的多模态衍生数据。四个互补任务涵盖乐谱理解、记谱转换、音频转录和符号生成。
tldr: ONOTE提出了一个统一框架，将音乐视为可测量的跨表征对应关系，并通过涵盖五线谱、简谱和指法谱的多样化基准，在四个互补任务中实现全模态推理，以解决现有记谱处理中的结构一致性缺失和偏见问题。
en_tdlr: ONOTE proposes a unified framework treating music as measurable cross-representation correspondences, and achieves omnimodal reasoning across four complementary tasks using a diverse benchmark covering staff, Jianpu, and tablature, addressing structural consistency gaps and biases in existing notation processing.
